rows.name: Fiscal 1991 receipts and summary of receipts (centre and right columns)

rows.what_it_is: Same quantity as annual-report-receipts. Textract split the page's three label|amount columns into two tables: this one holds the centre and right columns, including SUMMARY OF RECEIPTS and GRAND TOTAL $9532917.83; the left column (TAXES & EXCISES, INTEREST, DEMANDS, FEES) is 24/2. SCHOOL TRANSPORTATION $121543.00 is printed twice (rows 1 and 3; the page lines carry it twice too, p24 lines 5-6 and 17-18). The receipts emitter checks each TABLE against the GRAND TOTAL, so these rows fail for a structural reason (NEEDS.md); but the page does not foot even pooled: 24/1 + 24/2 accounts = 9,650,522.83 against GRAND TOTAL 9,532,917.83 (117,605.00 over). The TAXES & EXCISES category (6,533,682.04) ties exactly to 24/2 rows 2-33, and the SUMMARY OF RECEIPTS categories sum to the GRAND TOTAL
